canonical_data: Markdown files in the user's own Obsidian vault
strengths: One Markdown vault shared, unmodified, across eight AI-CLI hosts (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Antigravity, Hermes, Pi, Grok Bot)
Notes are rewritten and reconciled in place instead of only appended, under a documented freshness policy (OKM)
Ships its own retrieval-eval and per-host conformance-report commands to measure vault search quality
weaknesses: Single maintainer and six months old, with releases still at v0.15 (pre-1.0)
45-command surface adds real setup and learning overhead versus a simple notes app
Live research commands reach out to X, the web, and YouTube, so 'key-less' does not mean fully offline
why_it_matters: Shows a single human-owned Markdown vault, not a hosted service, can serve as portable long-term memory across eight independent coding-agent CLIs.
